name: sntl-depin
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP 2026-07-28 RC & 2025-11-25 stateless schema) server for DePIN RF telemetry, spatial heuristics, and threat intelligence. Exposes deterministic physics validation over 724k+ live records. Metered via HTTP 402 (x402Version: 2) on Solana Mainnet with tiered pay-per-record pricing ($0.01 - $1.00 USDC). Strict LIMIT 1 enforced. First tier free, zero registration.

WALLET_ENV.description: BYO Solana secret key (base58 or JSON) for paid tools

MAX_USDC_PER_CALL.description: hard spend cap per call (must be >= 1.00 to access Tier 1 RF/Critical tools)
